A clean, flat textbook-style timeline diagram of the four Rightly Guided Caliphs. From left to right along a central arrow line: Abu Bakr (632-634 CE / 11-13 AH), 'Umar (634-644 CE / 13-23 AH), 'Uthman (644-656 CE / 23-35 AH), 'Ali (656-661 CE / 35-40 AH). Below each name, a single icon representing their main achievement: a sword and shield (Abu Bakr - Riddah wars), a scroll/register ('Umar - Diwan/administration), an open book ('Uthman - standardized Mushaf), and a weighing scale ('Ali - justice/preservation). White background.
